title: VIX futures September 2027 expiration (SOQ settlement) — the same session as the FOMC decision, struck in the opening auction 4½ hours before the statement
source: EST: RULE-DERIVED from the venue's own contract specification and then VALIDATED AGAINST EIGHTEEN YEARS OF THE VENUE'S OWN SETTLEMENT PRINTS — a stronger check than any sibling in this class has run. THE RULE: cboe.com/tradable_products/vix/vix_futures/specifications/ fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 461,261 bytes, re-read verbatim out of the page's embedded payload this session rather than inherited) states 'The final settlement date for a contract with the "VX" ticker symbol is on the Wednesday that is 30 days prior to the third Friday of the calendar month immediately following the month in which the contract expires', and 'If that Wednesday or the Friday that is 30 days following that Wednesday is a Cboe Options holiday, the final settlement date for the contract shall be on the business day immediately preceding that Wednesday.' APPLIED COLD to the September 2027 contract (VX/U7): the third Friday of October 2027 is 2027-10-15; the Wednesday 30 calendar days prior is 2027-09-15; neither leg is a US market holiday (Labor Day 2027 is the FIRST Monday of September, 2027-09-06, nine days earlier, and no holiday falls on 2027-10-15), so the second clause does not fire and settlement stands on Wednesday 2027-09-15. THE VALIDATION, which is this entry's own contribution: applying that rule cold to every contract month from 2008-07 to 2026-09 produces 218 monthly settlement dates, and 217 of them appear in Cboe's own published VIX final-settlement series, cdn.cboe.com/api/global/us_indices/daily_prices/VRO_History.csv (HTTP 200, 26,597 bytes, 1,268 rows, fetched 2026-09-06). The single absence is a GAP IN CBOE'S FILE, not a rule failure — the series carries no May 2013 row of any date, jumping 04/17/2013 straight to 06/19/2013. All six historical displacements the holiday clause produces are reproduced exactly (2014-03-18, 2019-03-19, 2022-03-15, 2025-03-18 and 2026-05-19 off a Good-Friday/Juneteenth FRIDAY leg; 2024-06-18 off a Juneteenth WEDNESDAY leg). The rule also reproduces 9 of 9 currently listed VX settlement dates read from www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv?dt=2026-09-04 this session (HTTP 200 after a 301, 1,731 bytes): U6 2026-09-16, V6 2026-10-21, X6 2026-11-18, Z6 2026-12-16, F7 2027-01-20, G7 2027-02-17, H7 2027-03-17, J7 2027-04-21, K7 2027-05-18. WHY ESTIMATE AND NOT CONFIRMED: VX/U7 IS NOT LISTED on that surface — the published VX curve stops at K7 (May 2027), so this date is rule-and-arithmetic rather than a listing, and the OCC: prefix this class promotes under is not yet earned. Promote on VX/U7 appearing on a Cboe settlement or expiration-calendar surface. RECORDED BLOCK, not worked around: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars returned HTTP 403 to this runner on 2026-09-06 where the fomc-2027-09-15 lane got HTTP 200 the same day, and cboe.com/about/hours/us-options/ (HTTP 200, 386,016 bytes) still publishes a 2026 table only, so the 2027 holiday set here is the rule-derived US market calendar validated by the 217-of-218 reproduction above, not a re-read 2027 calendar page. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by this event's own initial research (docs/research/events/vix-expiration-2027-09-15.md, 2026-09-06) after reading the one prior proposal, proposals/vix-expiration-2027-09-15.from-fomc-2027-09-15.json, whose every claim was re-derived from the primaries rather than inherited. All held except its collision COUNT: the proposal recorded 45 of 167 FOMC meetings falling on a monthly VIX settlement, this session's independent re-derivation returns 41 of 167 — the Septembers agree exactly (13 of 21) and the structural claim is unaffected, but the four-meeting difference is unexplained and is recorded rather than reconciled away. THE FACT THIS ENTRY CARRIES: settlement lands ON the FOMC decision day. Cboe's spec ends trading in the expiring VX contract at 08:00 Chicago time (09:00 ET, five hours before the statement) and the SOQ is struck from the constituent SPX series' opening prints (09:30 ET, four and a half hours before it), so the September 2027 contract cash-settles BEFORE the 14:00 ET statement that sits inside its own 30-day reference window (2027-09-15 -> 2027-10-15, 23 trading sessions, no closures). AND THE STORY THAT INVITES IS MEASURED AND REFUSED. Naively the SOQ should print rich because the whole meeting is unresolved at hour zero; on 37 historical collisions 2008-2026 VIX instead OPENS 1.30% BELOW the prior close against +0.29% on non-collision settlements — the wrong sign. That difference then fails to survive its control: the same decline appears on FOMC days that are NOT settlements (-0.52% vs +0.83% elsewhere), and holding meeting type fixed (quarterly SEP-carrying decisions only, varying only the collision) the gap falls to -0.88 points at permutation P = 0.33, reversing sign in September alone (+0.10% on 11 collisions vs -1.38% on 7 non-collisions). The settlement print itself is flat: VRO against the same session's VIX open runs +0.14% on collisions vs +0.31% otherwise, P = 0.79. The collision is a scheduling fact with no measured price consequence. ALL 41 COLLISIONS 2007-2027 FALL IN MARCH, JUNE, SEPTEMBER OR DECEMBER -- every one is a SEP-carrying quarterly meeting, and roughly half of that class (41 of 83) collides; the calendar cannot produce one in the other eight months. Impact low; it supports one execution guard -- nothing reads the 2027-09-15 opening auction as information -- and licenses nothing. No house playbook is opex-, expiration- or vol-settlement-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped 2026-09-06, zero hits), consistent with what the vix-expiration-2027-05-18 lane found on 2026-09-05. Estimate widens caution only.
